description: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Julianne Smith, Former US Ambassador to NATO under the Biden Administration, discusses strain between the US and European allies, the potential implications for Russia, and concerns about long-term credibility and energy security tied to the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump to Address Nation on Iran War | Balance of Power: Late Edition 04/01/2026

description: Bloomberg’s Greg Stohr and Jeff Mason shares their insights on the United States Supreme Court hearing arguments challenging birthright citizenship and President Trump attending the arguments. They speak about what the potential outcome of the case may be & if the president’s presence made any impact during the hearing. Greg and Jeff speak with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg’s “Balance of Power.” (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Attends SCOTUS Debate on Birthright Citizenship

description: Julianne Smith, Former US Ambassador to NATO under the Biden Administration, discusses strain between the US and European allies, the potential implications for Russia, and concerns about long-term credibility and energy security tied to the Strait of Hormuz. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Threats Risk Emboldening Putin: Fmr. Amb. to NATO

author: Neil Jerome Morales
description: For the first time since the pandemic, Hiraya Mendez dropped plans to drive back to her home in Nueva Ecija province, about 100 kilometers (62 miles) from Manila, during the Easter holiday weekend that starts Thursday. Instead, she’s taking her two young cousins for a swim at a condominium she’s renting near the capital.
title: Oil Shock Curbs Easter Travel in the Philippines as People Pare Back

author: Ryan Gallagher
description: US Immigration and Custom Enforcement has said it purchased spyware designed to hack phones and access encrypted messages as part of an effort to counter the flow of fentanyl into the US.
title: ICE Tells Lawmakers It’s Using Spyware in Fight Against Fentanyl

author: Golnar Motevalli
description: Airstrikes are hitting residential areas and industrial facilities, according to reports from inside Iran.
title: US, Israel Continue Attacks on Iran’s Civilian Infrastructure

author: Courtney Subramanian
description: The Trump administration is preparing to set a tariff rate of 25% on finished products made with imported steel and aluminum, according to the Wall Street Journal, an effort to streamline levies on metals and make it easier for companies to navigate President Donald Trump’s import taxes.
title: US to Set 25% Tariff on Finished Steel, Aluminum Goods, WSJ Says

author: Ted Mann
description: The president watched court arguments and is set to give address tonight
title: Trump Confronts Two Legacy-Defining Issues: Immigration and War

author: Alex Vasquez, Gonzalo Soto
description: Mexico’s Deputy Minister for North America Roberto Velasco is poised to take the top role as Foreign Minister as outgoing head Juan Ramon de la Fuente prepares to step down, according to people with direct knowledge of the matter.
title: Velasco Poised to Be Top Mexico Diplomat After Minister Resigns

description: President Donald Trump has once again lashed out at America’s NATO partners, this time over their unwillingness to help him prosecute the war in Iran, and suggested the US may even quit the military alliance. Tyler Kendall has more  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Can Trump Really Pull the US Out of NATO?

author: Maggie Otte
description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian posted a letter to Americans on X on Wednesday. Read the full text of his letter here:
title: Read the Text of the Iranian President’s Letter to Americans

description: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec speak with Bloomberg Balance of Power co-host Kailey Leinz about what to expect from President Trump's primetime address to the nation tonight. Then, Andrew Szczurowski, strategic income portfolio manager at Morgan Stanley Investment Management, discusses the macro environment and market reaction to the president's moves as the war with Iran drags on. Plus, Ed Ludlow joins from Kennedy Space Center ahead of the scheduled NASA Artemis II launch, as the US prepares to send astronauts back to the moon. Finally, Rebecca Homkes on how she advises leaders to handle volatility as the markets work through unpredictability around impact from global conflict. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump to Tout Iran Wins in Address Amid War Uncertainty | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 4/1/2026

author: Mathieu Dion
description: Canadian entrepreneur Andrew Lutfy was upbeat after his fast-fashion retailer, Groupe Dynamite Inc., reported excellent results. But before digging into the financial details with analysts, he decided to go on a rant about politics — in French.
title: Canadian Billionaire Rants About Quebec Policies to Analysts in French

author: Andrea Palasciano, Jamie Tarabay
description: President Donald Trump has once again lashed out at America’s NATO partners, this time over their unwillingness to help him prosecute the war in Iran, and suggested the US may even quit the military alliance.
title: Can Trump Really Pull the US Out of NATO?

description: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss the latest from the Middle East. On today's show, former Vice President Mike Pence, Republican Congressman Mike Haridopolos, Stonecourt Capital Partner Rick Davis, Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino and Gulf Oil Chief Energy Advisor Tom Kloza. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Outlines Ceasefire Demands | Balance of Power: Early Edition 4/01/2026

author: Kate Sullivan, Eric Martin
description: President Donald Trump’s threat to exit NATO as retaliation for the bloc’s failure to help reopen the Strait of Hormuz faces a major obstacle — one that comes from his very own Secretary of State, Marco Rubio.
title: Trump NATO Exit Threat Faces Hurdle From His Top Diplomat’s Past

author: Alicia Diaz
description: President Donald Trump’s long reticence on how to clear a stalemate and fund the Department of Homeland Security showed signs of thaw after he issued a social media post on Wednesday calling for movement in a Republican-controlled Congress extraordinarily reliant on his direction.
title: Trump’s Heavy Hand in Congress Backfires With DHS Stuck in Limbo

author: Alexander Sazonov
description: Russian state nuclear company Rosatom is preparing a final wave of evacuations from the Bushehr power plant in Iran as conditions near the reactor escalate.
title: Rosatom Evacuates Staff From Iranian Reactor on Safety Concerns

author: Jorgelina Do Rosario
description: The International Monetary Fund, the World Bank Group and the International Energy Agency said they’ll work together to respond to the economic fallout of the Iran war.
title: IMF, World Bank and IEA to Coordinate Efforts Around Iran War

author: Fran Wang
description: An influential journal of China’s leading Communist Party published a rare warning about risks associated with the nation’s gaping trade surpluses, saying that pushing exports too far can expose the economy to vulnerabilities at home and abroad.
title: China Communist Journal Issues a Rare Call to Curb Trade Surplus

author: Zoe Tillman
description: The US Justice Department is appealing a federal judge’s order earlier this year that required immigration authorities to release a 5-year-old boy whose photo became a symbol of the Trump administration’s hardline policies.
title: US to Appeal Order Releasing 5-Year-Old Boy Detained in Texas

author: Hadriana Lowenkron, Jeff Mason
description: President Donald Trump will hail his military campaign in Iran as a success during a Wednesday prime-time address and stress that the conclusion of operations may come in two-to-three weeks, according to a White House official.
title: Trump to Tout Military Gains, Push Two-to-Three-Week Iran Exit

description: Former Vice President Mike Pence says Iran has been a problem for 47 years and he's glad President Donald Trump "pulled the trigger" and took action against the regime. Pence is on "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Former VP Pence Happy Trump Pulled 'Trigger' on Iran

author: Erik Hertzberg
description: While the Bank of Canada’s governing council spent considerable time discussing the inflation risks posed by the war in Iran, officials agreed that they “should not lose sight” of other major economic headwinds when they held interest rates steady last month.
title: Bank of Canada Agreed Iran War Shouldn’t Overtake Other Risks

author: Laura Nahmias, Nacha Cattan
description: New York City Council Speaker Julie Menin outlined a budget proposal that she said would close a $6 billion deficit without raising taxes, cutting services or raiding the city’s savings — a plan Mayor Zohran Mamdani immediately deemed “unrealistic.”
title: Mamdani Spars With NYC City Council Over $127 Billion Budget

author: Magdalena Del Valle
description: The United Arab Emirates called on the United Nations to authorize a range of measures, including force, to reopen the Strait of Hormuz as Persian Gulf countries pressure Iran to restore free passage along the vital global energy corridor.
title: UAE Asks UN to Approve Measures, Including Force, to Open Hormuz

author: Kate Sullivan
description: President Donald Trump is set to deliver a rare primetime address on Iran amid uncertainty about how long he’s prepared to continue a five-week war that has largely shuttered the Strait of Hormuz.
title: Trump Set to Address Nation on Iran as US Seeks War Off-Ramp

author: Anna Edgerton, Dina Katgara
description: Seattle’s plan to overhaul the cultural campus around the Space Needle is colliding with a basic dilemma: The city is running out of legal room to raise taxes.
title: Tax Limits Steer Seattle to $1.5 Billion Space Needle Arts Bond

author: Greg Stohr
description: The US Supreme Court cast doubt on President Donald Trump’s bid to roll back automatic birthright citizenship, signaling the justices are likely to deal him a fresh rebuke and reject a central plank of his immigration agenda.
title: Supreme Court Skeptical of Trump’s Birthright Citizenship Curbs

author: Paul Vecchiatto
description: Almost half of South Africa’s wastewater facilities are in a critical state, raising the risk of them discharging untreated water into rivers and the environment.
title: Half of South Africa Wastewater Plants Deemed in Critical State

author: Andrea Palasciano, Andra Timu, Ellen Milligan
description: European allies are skeptical Donald Trump will actually pull the US out of NATO. But they still fear the president’s renewed threats to do so are eroding the military alliance at a precarious moment.
title: NATO Worries Trump Will Weaken Alliance as US Threatens Exit

author: Zoe Tillman
description: More than five years after violent riots at the US Capitol, President Donald Trump still can’t avoid lawsuits seeking to hold him legally responsible for the chaos that temporarily disrupted Congress’ certification of the 2020 election.
title: Trump Can’t Shake Claims Over Jan. 6 Capitol Attack Years Later

description: President Donald Trump is at the US Supreme Court listening in on oral arguments as justices consider the constitutionality of his bid to curb who is eligible for automatic citizenship when born in the US. It’s the first time a sitting president has ever attended an argument in recorded Supreme Court history. Bloomberg’s Tyler Kendall is there.
title: Trump at Supreme Court for Birthright Citizenship Case

description: Nouriel Roubini, chairman of Roubini Macro Associates, says the war in Iran has been a disaster for President Donald Trump, but he has to finish the job. Roubini speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Roubini Says Iran War Has Been a Failure for Trump

description: Senator Mark Kelly of Arizona, a former astronaut, talks about the Artemis II mission and calls it inspiring. He says he wants to see the US beat China to the moon. He speaks to Bloomberg from Kennedy Space Center in Florida. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Sen. Kelly Wants to Beat China to the Moon

author: Greg Stohr
description: President Donald Trump arrived at the US Supreme Court on Wednesday as justices consider the constitutionality of his bid to curb who is eligible for automatic citizenship when born in the US. It’s the first time a sitting president has attended an argument in recorded Supreme Court history.
title: Trump Arrives at Supreme Court for Birthright Citizenship Case

description: Nouriel Roubini, chairman of Roubini Macro Associates, says President Donald Trump has no choice but to escalate and finish the war in Iran. He says so far, it's been a disaster. He speaks on Bloomberg Surveillance. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Has to Finish the War in Iran, Roubini Says

author: Kate Sullivan
description: President Donald Trump said the US would only consider agreeing to a ceasefire with Iran if the Strait of Hormuz is reopened, offering his latest signal about an exit plan from the war.
title: Trump Says US Will Consider Iran Ceasefire When Hormuz Opens

author: Irina Anghel
description: Artificial intelligence threatens to leave many of the UK’s best-paid workers without a job — and the government without a crucial source of tax revenue, according to a new report.
title: AI Puts UK’s High-Paid Jobs and Tax Revenues at Risk, Study Says

author: Annie Massa, Ben Bartenstein
description: Powerus, a drone company backed by President Donald Trump’s eldest sons, has met with officials in Abu Dhabi to discuss selling weapons to the United Arab Emirates as the country looks to shore up its defense systems against attacks from Iran, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
title: Drone Firm Backed by Trump Sons Is Pitching UAE on Weapons Deal

description:
London is becoming a trap for young people hunting for their first job, as higher taxes and AI squeeze opportunities.

Irina Anghel explains. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Why Young People Can’t Find a Job in London Anymore

author: Alex Dooler
description: Some Iranian nationals are now barred from entering or transiting through the United Arab Emirates, according to the country’s flagship airlines, as the regional war enters its second month.

author: Jonathan Tamari
description: Justices will decide key question of who is an American
title: Trump’s Birthright Citizenship Policy Gets Supreme Court Hearing

description: Prime Minister Keir Starmer said the UK must deepen its relationship with Europe as the fallout from the Middle East conflict stretches into a second month. “It is increasingly clear that as the world continues down this volatile path, our long-term national interest requires closer partnership with our allies in Europe, and with the European Union,” Starmer said during a press conference in Downing Street. “We want to be more ambitious.” (Source: Bloomberg)
title: UK's Starmer Urges Deeper EU Ties With World on 'Volatile Path'

author: Joe Mayes
description: Keir Starmer said the UK will coordinate a diplomatic push to reopen the Strait of Hormuz as the US-Israeli war with Iran threatens to derail economies around the world and fracture the transatlantic alliance.

description: The UK government’s Low Pay Commission defended large hikes in the minimum wage for under 21-year-olds, following concern that it’s fueled a surge in youth unemployment.

description: India and most of South Asia are already seeing the war hit their economies.

description: US government requests for user data from technology companies has skyrocketed by 770% in the past decade, a new research report has concluded.

description: Prime Minister Keir Starmer said the UK must deepen its relationship with Europe, as the US-Israeli war with Iran threatens to derail economies across the continent and fracture the transatlantic alliance.

description: Giorgia Meloni’s government is working on an extension of a fuel tax cut it approved last month, according to an Italian official, as the premier hopes to blunt the economic impact of the Iran war.

author: Daniel Carvalho, Daniela Milanese, Andre Loureiro Dias, Franco Dantas
description: Ahead of October elections, a president forged out of Brazil’s industrial labor movement can no longer count on support from the workers of today.

description: An American freelance journalist has been kidnapped in Baghdad, probably by an Iran-backed militia, according to the US State Department, Iraqi authorities and Al-Monitor, a Washington-based news site to which the reporter was affiliated.

description: Hungary’s surging opposition movement further widened its lead over Prime Minister Viktor Orban’s ruling party in a fresh poll, the second survey in a week suggesting the nationalist leader may be facing a major election loss this month.

description: Missile and drone attacks continued across the Middle East even after US President Donald Trump signaled the war could end soon, lifting Asian stocks.

description: Thailand is turning to its billionaire-led conglomerates to help contain rising living costs, underscoring both the urgency of inflation pressures and the outsized role of big business in the country’s economy.

description: The UAE is prepared to help the US open the Strait of Hormuz by force and seeks the creation of a coalition of allies to do so, according to the Wall Street Journal. Bloomberg's Joumanna Bercetche has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

description: Vladimir Putin made a big deal of Russia’s success in seizing control of Kupyansk in eastern Ukraine late last year, even as Volodymyr Zelenskiy immediately challenged the claim by making a video address from the town.

description: President Donald Trump said he foresaw ending the war on Iran within two to three weeks, suggesting the US had largely accomplished its military goals and would leave it to other nations to resolve issues with the Strait of Hormuz. Patrick Schoettmer, Associate Professor of Political Science at Seattle University spoke to Bloomberg’s Horizons Middle East and Africa anchor Joumanna Bercetche on the US reaction to the Iran war. (Source: Bloomberg)

description: Countries across Asia are limiting consumers’ fuel purchases. Run by a junta and facing civil war, Myanmar is among the hardest hit.

author: Laura Noonan
description: Europe’s financial supervision battles are usually fought diplomatically. A tersely worded statement here, a veiled signal there. But on the tiny island of Malta — home to golden visas, legalized cannabis and a massive gambling industry — the rules of engagement are different.

description: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese will deliver a rare national address on Wednesday evening, setting out the government’s response to the Iran war, which has disrupted energy supplies and driven up global oil prices.

description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump plans to sit in on Wednesday’s Supreme Court hearing on birthright citizenship, making him the first sitting president to attend oral arguments at the nation’s highest court.
title: Trump Plans to Attend Supreme Court Hearing on His Bid to Limit Birthright Citizenship

description: Jessica Genauer, an expert in international conflict at the UNSW Public Policy Institute, shares her insights about how Iran is seeking to counter the enormous military advantage of the US. (Source: Bloomberg)
